title: Why was I charged a transfer fee on my Gold Account?
summary: This document explains the expected transfer-fee policy for a Gold Account tier where transfer fees are “Yes,” and provides reasons you may still see additional charges from third parties or external networks. It also lists steps to verify the fee originator via your activity feed/confirmation and what to share with support (transaction date, amount, reference ID).
